code: s <- default_settings(d) res <- run_analysis(clusnalyst_demo("snp"), s) cat(build_script(s, list(demo = "snp"))) #> # Clusnalyst analysis script #> # Written by clusnalyst 0.1.0 on 2026-10-14 #> # Install once with: #> # install.packages("clusnalyst", repos = c("https://ebenogoe.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")) #>  #> library(clusnalyst) #>  #> d <- clusnalyst_demo("snp") #>  #> settings <- list(align = NULL, filter = list(max_marker_missing = 0.2, min_maf = 0.05,  #>     drop_monomorphic = TRUE, max_sample_missing = 0.5, drop_empty_sites = TRUE),  #>     distance = list(method = "ibs", sqrt_binary = FALSE, scale = TRUE),  #>     tree = list(method = "upgma", outgroup = NULL), bootstrap = list(B = 100,  #>         seed = 1), k = list(k_max = 10, gap = FALSE, seed = 1), groups = list( #>         method = "tree", k = 3, ordination = "pcoa", seed = 1)) #>  #> res <- run_analysis(d, settings, progress = message) #>  #> # Distances, tree and groups #> dist_matrix <- as.matrix(res$dist) #> res$tree #> if (!is.null(res$groups)) table(res$groups) #>  #> # Plots #> plot_tree(res$tree, groups = res$groups, group_title = "Cluster", support = res$boot$support) #> if (!is.null(res$kres)) plot_k(res$kres) #> if (!is.null(res$ord)) plot_ordination(res$ord, groups = res$groups, group_title = "Cluster") #>  #> # Save the tree in Newick format #> tr <- res$tree$phylo #> if (!is.null(res$boot)) tr$node.label <- round(res$boot$support) #> ape::write.tree(tr, "clusnalyst_tree.nwk")

title: Point-and-Click Cluster Analysis of Molecular and Trait Data
text: Clusnalyst point--click app cluster analysis molecular trait data. give marker table, VCF, HapMap file, trait sheet FASTA file. builds tree, tells far trust branch many groups data supports, gives report R script repeats every step. Try browser: https://ebenogoe.shinyapps.io/clusnalyst/

title: Point-and-Click Cluster Analysis of Molecular and Trait Data
text: Data. Reads CSV, TSV Excel tables, VCF, HapMap FASTA. works data type whether markers rows columns, can correct either. Sample information (population, origin, coordinates) can added second table. Quality check. Missing data per marker per sample, minor allele frequency heterozygosity, filters. Unaligned sequences aligned ClustalOmega, ClustalW MUSCLE msa package. Distances. Jaccard, Dice simple matching bands; allele sharing (IBS), modified Rogers Euclidean SNPs; Euclidean, Manhattan Gower traits; K80, JC69, TN93 p-distance sequences. Tree. UPGMA, WPGMA, single, complete Ward linkage, neighbour joining BIONJ, optional rooting outgroup. cophenetic correlation table ranks methods distances. Validate. Bootstrap support resampled markers, number groups silhouette width, elbow gap statistic, Mantel tests second matrix sample coordinates. Groups. Cut tree, use PAM k-means, look groups PCoA PCA plot. Report. self-contained HTML report, R script, figures PNG, SVG PDF, tables CSV Excel, Newick tree session file can reopen later.

title: Point-and-Click Cluster Analysis of Molecular and Trait Data
text: hosted app limits (30 MB files, 300 sequences, 1,000 bootstrap replicates). computer none. Every step also function, can script : run_analysis() runs one settings list, app’s R script download uses.
code: install.packages("clusnalyst", repos = c("https://ebenogoe.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")) clusnalyst::run_app() library(clusnalyst) d <- read_markers("my_markers.csv") d <- filter_data(d, max_marker_missing = 0.2, min_maf = 0.05) dm <- compute_distance(d, "ibs") tr <- build_tree(dm, "upgma") boot <- bootstrap_tree(d, tr, "ibs", B = 500, seed = 1) plot_tree(tr, support = boot$support, support_min = 50) optimal_k(dm, tr, gap = TRUE)$best_silhouette

Three simulated labelled : 60 lines three populations 1,000 SNPs, 30 accessions 60 ISSR bands, 40 cowpea-like accessions mixed traits. two come packages: woodmouse cytochrome b alignment ape, hemoglobin alpha protein sequences msa. scripts make simulated sets data-raw/.

title: Point-and-Click Cluster Analysis of Molecular and Trait Data
text: Clusnalyst began 2022 final-year project Kwame Nkrumah University Science Technology (Project Genaxy: Ebenezer Ogoe, Michael Obeng Stephen Amoako). version single Shiny file. one rewrite R package. Besides new data types checks, fixes four problems original: single complete linkage options ran Ward’s method, bootstrap support came resampling distance matrix rather markers, sessions hosted app shared data, aligned FASTA files crashed . title: clusnalyst: Point-and-Click Cluster Analysis of Molecular and Trait Data — clusnalyst-package
text: 'shiny' application set plain R functions clustering samples dominant markers, SNP genotypes (CSV, VCF HapMap), quantitative mixed traits, DNA protein sequences. computes distance matrices, builds trees UPGMA, WPGMA, single, complete Ward linkage, neighbour joining BIONJ, checks marker bootstrap support (Felsenstein 1985 doi:10.1111/j.1558-5646.1985.tb00420.x ), cophenetic correlation, average silhouette width, gap statistic Mantel tests. also offers principal coordinates principal components, k-means partitioning around medoids, exports self-contained HTML report R script reproduces analysis.

title: clusnalyst 0.1.0
text: Reads 0/1 band tables, SNP genotypes letters, 0/1/2, VCF HapMap, measured categorical traits, DNA protein FASTA. data type table layout detected can overridden. Quality check step filters missing data, minor allele frequency markers vary. Sequences aligned ClustalOmega, ClustalW MUSCLE. New distances: allele sharing (IBS), modified Rogers, Euclidean, Manhattan, Gower, K80, JC69, TN93 p-distance sequences. New tree methods: WPGMA, Ward, BIONJ, NJ rooted outgroup. cophenetic correlation table compares . Number groups silhouette width, within-group sum squares gap statistic. Mantel tests second matrix numeric sample information location. PCoA PCA, groups cutting tree, PAM k-means. Interactive trees plots, sample information hover, light dark themes, guided tour. Downloads: PNG, SVG PDF every figure, CSV Excel tables, Newick trees, HTML report, R script repeats analysis, session file.
